main.description: A response (accept or decline) to a draw offer, written into the RESPONDING player's own repository. AT Protocol does not permit writing into another account's repository, so a response cannot be recorded by mutating the app.atchess.drawOffer record itself (which lives in the OFFERING player's repo) -- it always lives with its author, the responder, and references both the original offer and the game by strongRef so a reader can find it either way without a second lookup.

drawOffer.description: Reference (uri + cid) to the original app.atchess.drawOffer record in the offering player's repo

game.description: Reference (uri + cid) to the app.atchess.game record this draw offer belongs to, duplicated here (rather than requiring a join through drawOffer) so a reader deriving game state can filter directly by game URI

respondedBy.description: DID of the player who responded
